title: bmc brewing
venue_description:
About bmc brewing

bmc brewing (Bite My Cookies Brewing Company) is a family-owned and operated nanobrewery that opened in mid-2021 after more than 30 years in the making. The Rice family who owns the brewery formerly worked as scientists in drug discovery cell biology biochemistry and agriculture while dabbling in homebrewing on the side. This unique background inspires their creative beer names like Mendel's Dominant Recessive Kölsch (named after the founder of modern genetics) and Hopper's German Wheat Ale (honoring computer scientist Grace Hopper).

The Brewing Experience

The brewery features 18 taps filled with beer brewed on-site using ultra-purified reverse osmosis water which allows better batch-to-batch consistency. They source ingredients as locally as possible including grains from Epiphany Craft Malt in Durham hops from Bee Hoppy Farms in Chatham County and coffee roasted on-site by Vortex Roasters. Their beer selection includes everything from traditional styles like Kolsch Pale Ale Stout and IPA to innovative seasonal offerings. In addition to their own beers they feature one tap with Hopped Hard Cider and rotating flavored meads from neighbors Chatham Cider Works and Starrlight Mead.

Sustainability and Community

bmc brewing is deeply committed to sustainability and community. They use as much solar power as possible to run the brewery and taproom. Their unique approach to sustainability includes processing spent grains from brewing into flour to make delicious cookies sold to customers - hence the full name Bite My Cookies Brewing Company. This gives them both a fun story and a tasty treat to share with visitors.

The Venue Space

The building houses the taproom brewery and the Smelt Art Gallery. The converted space has a quirky industrial vibe with artsy decor that creates a relaxed welcoming atmosphere. Both indoor and outdoor seating options are available allowing guests to enjoy their beverages in the scenic surroundings of The Plant campus. The venue is dog-friendly in outdoor areas.

Music and Events

bmc brewing hosts a robust calendar of musical events including Songwriter Open Mic nights. On select Sundays from 2-5 PM they welcome both original songs and covers. Thursday evenings at 7 PM feature original-song-only open mics. These events are hosted by Michael J. Brennan in a singers-in-the-round format where performers take turns and donations are split evenly among all artists. The venue also features pint nights special deals Sunday Brunch game nights and live music performances. They've partnered with neighbors at The Plant on collaborations and pairing dinners creating a vibrant community hub for craft beverages and acoustic music.

Location and Accessibility

Located at The Plant in Pittsboro bmc brewing is part of the Chatham Beverage District and the Chatham County Craft Beverages and Country Inns Trail. The 17-acre campus is also home to Starrlight Mead Fair Game Beverage Copeland Springs Farm & Kitchen and many other local businesses. Visitors can explore the entire property enjoying multiple beverage options art installations and outdoor activities all in one location.

title: The City Tap
venue_description:
About The City Tap

The City Tap has been a beloved fixture in downtown Pittsboro serving the community as a gathering place for craft beer enthusiasts music lovers and food aficionados. Often described as Pittsboro's version of the town pump this establishment has built a strong reputation for its welcoming atmosphere quality offerings and commitment to supporting local culture.

Food and Beverage

The City Tap offers North Carolina brewed craft beers featuring an interesting and carefully curated selection on tap. The kitchen despite being small turns out surprisingly good food with a menu focused on delicious sandwiches soups and salads using only the finest ingredients. Popular items include The Mediterranean sandwich The Reuben (frequently praised by customers) pulled pork pita with fresh guac pickled onions and cilantro and the turkey guac sandwich. The Chatham Chutney sandwich features sharp cheddar Granny Smith apples onion on sourdough bread smothered with local Kerala Curry chutney available in mild or hot. The venue also serves wine and cocktails with both indoor and outdoor seating options.

Music Programming and Events

The City Tap has earned recognition as a significant part of the downtown Pittsboro music scene hosting live music several nights a week. Their signature music event is Tap In: A Listening Experience co-hosted by longtime Chatham musicians Dave Smith and Tracy Lynn on the second and fourth Wednesday of every month from 7-9 PM. This intimate acoustic-only space features original songs from the hosts and at 8 PM shifts to a Featured Spotlight Artist segment where the floor is open to any performers at any skill level.

Live Music Schedule

The venue regularly features live performances on their patio with no cover charge though tipping musicians is recommended. Past performers have included bands and artists such as Trash Van Fever performing Irish and eclectic music Mike Edwards and His Only Friends Bad Penny and various local and regional musicians. The patio provides an excellent outdoor setting for enjoying music on pleasant evenings.

Community Atmosphere

The City Tap serves as a true community hub in downtown Pittsboro. Customers consistently praise the friendly service welcoming vibe and the venue's role as a social gathering spot. The establishment has been part of Pittsboro's downtown scene for many years celebrating milestones and hosting everything from casual lunches to special music events. On Mondays they feature market meals with specials based on seasonal items from the Chatham Miles Farmers Market.

Additional Details

The venue offers both indoor and outdoor seating options making it comfortable year-round. Payment methods include all major credit cards and cash. The City Tap is pet-friendly and child-friendly making it accessible for families. Special promotions have included dollar-off draft beers on open mic nights and Vinyl Nite events featuring cocktails love songs and desserts from local bakeries.

title: The Plant / Fair Game Beverage Company
venue_description:
About The Plant

The Plant is a diverse 17-acre eco-industrial park located on the eastern edge of Pittsboro North Carolina. This unique campus is home to nearly two dozen like-minded small businesses focused on entrepreneurship sustainability and supporting Chatham County's local economy. What began as an old biodiesel plant on a former farm has been transformed into a vibrant community hub that has turned local commerce into a multi-faceted experience.

The Campus Experience

The Plant offers visitors an exceptional array of experiences all in one location. The campus features the Smelt Art Gallery axe throwing at Chatham Axes walking trails unique craft beverage experiences at multiple producers farm-to-fork eateries including Copeland Springs Kitchen and Kingston 99 Jamaican food numerous outdoor spaces for gatherings and events and much more. Additional businesses include Vortex Roasters coffee at Metal Brixx Cafe hemp products from Oak City Hemp and Hempsmith Carolina Hemp Tours a native plants nursery and Pittsboro eBikes. The property includes a giant chess set in the yard a stage for live music swings playground equipment and even a constructed wetland for environmental education.

The Chatham Beverage District

The Plant is home to the renowned Chatham Beverage District which includes Fair Game Beverage Company bmc brewing Starrlight Mead & Cider and Koshu Sake. This concentration of craft beverage producers allows visitors to sample spirits beers meads ciders and sake all within walking distance. The campus is part of the Chatham County Craft Beverages and Country Inns Trail making it a destination for beverage enthusiasts.

Fair Game Beverage Company

Fair Game Beverage Company is North Carolina's 13th distillery and a cornerstone of The Plant's beverage offerings. Head distiller Chris Jude specializes in small-batch spirits distilled from locally grown produce turned into delicious seasonal cocktails. Their spirit lineup includes the award-winning Flying Pepper Vodka Balancing Act Gin Amber Rum and Province of Carolina rum (a blend of artisan rums from North and South Carolina). They also produce house-made liqueurs from seasonal fruits and fortified wines that have gained regional acclaim.

The Tasting Room and Wheelhouse

Fair Game operates a Tasting Room featuring flights and cocktails where visitors can sample their spirits. The Tasting Room also includes a pantry stocked with North Carolina specialty food products including cocktail supplies like bitters syrups and shrubs plus shelves of pickles hot sauces crackers caviar chocolates peanuts mustards and jams including Cackalacky products. Adjacent to the Tasting Room is the Wheelhouse - the Events Bar space that serves as a versatile venue for gatherings. The Wheelhouse hosts private parties corporate events and regular community programming.

Music and Cultural Events at The Plant

The Plant has developed an active calendar of musical and cultural events making it a hub for arts and entertainment in Chatham County. Fair Game's Wheelhouse hosts Open Mic nights on the first and third Wednesday of each month from 6:30-9 PM welcoming all musicians to share their talents. Other regular events include monthly Trivia hosted by Erin Poetry Readings on the second Wednesday of each month from 6-7 PM Irish Music nights featuring traditional tunes and Improv Theatre performances.

Annual Festivals and Special Events

The Plant grounds host numerous annual festivals that draw visitors from across the region including Hemparoo PBO Pride Okra Jamboree PepperFest Mead Fest Death Faire and Chestnut Carnival. The campus also accommodates conferences workshops art openings birthdays weddings funerals and corporate gatherings. Every Sunday from 10 AM to 3 PM the campus offers a special brunch experience with special menus drink offerings live music axe throwing and shopping. The Pittsboro Farmers Market operates year-round every Thursday under the solar panels.

Tours and Educational Opportunities

Fair Game offers public tours of their distillery on Saturdays at noon with additional tours available by appointment. These tours provide insight into the craft of distilling and the sustainable practices employed. Private whiskey tastings can be booked where participants build their own charcuterie boards and learn about flavor profiles from the head distiller with the option to purchase custom bottle blends. Carolina Hemp Tours offers educational experiences about hemp cultivation and products.

Sustainability and Community Values

The Plant was awarded the North Carolina Business Council 2023 Sustainable Business of the Year recognizing their commitment to environmental stewardship. The campus uses extensive solar power installations which also provide shade for the weekly farmers market. The businesses work collaboratively supporting each other and creating a model for sustainable local economic development. This commitment to sustainability entrepreneurship and community building has made The Plant a unique and beloved destination in the Triangle region.

Practical Information

The Plant is located at the end of Lorax Lane just off US Highway 64 on the eastern edge of Pittsboro. The campus layout encourages wandering and exploration with beverages from one venue welcome at outdoor spaces throughout the property. Ample parking is available and the entire campus maintains a family-friendly welcoming atmosphere. Most venues are dog-friendly in outdoor areas. Regular operating hours vary by individual business but the campus generally operates seven days a week with extended hours on weekends.
